name: Azure Audit - Resource Usage - New
description: Use this dashboard to see the details on resource group and resource provider.
title: Azure Audit - Resource Usage - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/Audit ((PROVIDERS resourceId operationName) or (ResourceProviderName OperationName))
| json "operationName", "OperationName" as OperationName1, OperationName2 nodrop // "operationName" EventHub, "OperationName" Azure Insight API 
| json "resourceId" as resourceId1 nodrop // EventHub
| parse regex field=resourceId1 "/PROVIDERS/(?<ResourceProviderName1>[^/]+)" nodrop // EventHub
| json "ResourceProviderName" as ResourceProviderName2 nodrop // Azure Insight API using our Powershell scripts 
| concat (OperationName1, OperationName2) as OperationName
| if (isEmpty(ResourceProviderName1), ResourceProviderName2, ResourceProviderName1) as ResourceProviderName
| parse field=operationName "/*" as action
| where !isEmpty(ResourceProviderName)
| tolowercase(ResourceProviderName) as ResourceProviderName
| fields ResourceProviderName, action, OperationName
|where if ("{{resourceprovidername}}" = "*", true, resourceprovidername matches "{{resourceprovidername}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}")
|count by ResourceProviderName, action
| transpose row ResourceProviderName column action

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/Audit ((resourceId ("PROVIDERS" or "RESOURCEGROUPS")) or (ResourceGroupName ResourceProviderName))
| json "operationName", "OperationName" as OperationName1, OperationName2 nodrop // "operationName" EventHub, "OperationName" Azure Insight API 
| concat (OperationName1, OperationName2) as OperationName
| json "resourceId" as resourceId1 nodrop // EventHub
| parse regex field=resourceId1 "/RESOURCEGROUPS/(?<ResourceGroupName1>[^/]+)" nodrop // EventHub
| parse regex field=resourceId1 "/PROVIDERS/(?<ResourceProviderName1>[^/]+)" nodrop // EventHub
| json "ResourceGroupName" as ResourceGroupName2 nodrop // Azure Insight API using our Powershell scripts 
| json "ResourceProviderName" as ResourceProviderName2 nodrop // Azure Insight API using our Powershell scripts 
| if (isEmpty(ResourceGroupName1), ResourceGroupName2, ResourceGroupName1) as ResourceGroupName
| if (isEmpty(ResourceProviderName1), ResourceProviderName2, ResourceProviderName1) as ResourceProviderName
| toLowerCase(ResourceGroupName) as ResourceGroupName | tolowercase(ResourceProviderName) as ResourceProviderName
| fields ResourceGroupName, ResourceProviderName, OperationName
|where if ("{{resourceprovidername}}" = "*", true, resourceprovidername matches "{{resourceprovidername}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroupname}}" = "*", true, resourcegroupname matches "{{resourcegroupname}}")
|count by ResourceGroupName, ResourceProviderName
| where !(isEmpty(ResourceGroupName) and isEmpty(ResourceProviderName))
| transpose row ResourceGroupName column ResourceProviderName

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/Audit ((resourceId RESOURCEGROUPS) or (ResourceGroupName))
| json "resourceId" as resourceId1 nodrop // EventHub
| parse regex field=resourceId1 "/RESOURCEGROUPS/(?<ResourceGroupName1>[^/]+)" nodrop
| json "ResourceGroupName" as ResourceGroupName2 nodrop // Azure Insight API using our Powershell scripts 
| if (isEmpty(ResourceGroupName1), ResourceGroupName2, ResourceGroupName1) as ResourceGroupName
| where !isEmpty(ResourceGroupName)
| tolowercase(ResourceGroupName) as ResourceGroupName
| fields ResourceGroupName
| timeslice 1d
|where if ("{{resourcegroupname}}" = "*", true, resourcegroupname matches "{{resourcegroupname}}")
|count by ResourceGroupName, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column ResourceGroupName

_sourceCategory = Labs/Azure/Audit ((resourceId RESOURCEGROUPS) or (ResourceGroupName))
| json "resourceId" as resourceId1 nodrop // EventHub
| parse regex field=resourceId1 "/RESOURCEGROUPS/(?<ResourceGroupName1>[^/]+)" nodrop
| json "ResourceGroupName" as ResourceGroupName2 nodrop // Azure Insight API using our Powershell scripts

| fields ResourceGroupName
| timeslice 1d
|where if ("{{resourcegroupname}}" = "*", true, resourcegroupname matches "{{resourcegroupname}}")
|count by ResourceGroupName
| sort by _count desc
